It is with profound regret that we advise the passing of Harry Evans in his sixtieth year of membership; and it is with gratitude that we recall his many years of service to the Club and the Sport.

He will be remembered as one of the bravest Metropolitan Policemen ever, and the recipient of many awards for gallantry and devotion td duty, the last one from the hands of Her Majesty The Queen. He was featured in the television series "This is your life" some years ago, in which the late Harry Evans also appeared.
